extension.summary: Your NAS, Plex-style - and new media saved straight to it
extension.description: StashBox turns the films and shows on your NAS into a Plex-style library: posters, Continue Watching, Next Up, Recently Added, collections, resume points and missing-episode tracking. It also finds new films and episodes, sends them through TorBox, Real-Debrid or Cocoleech, and saves them to your NAS with tidy Plex-style names in the background.
extension.news: 1.6.0 - copies and picture quality: every copy is labelled SD / 720p / 1080p / 4K (from its name, or read from the file's own header); 'Which copy?' when playing (or always the best); films and shows by picture quality; Tools > Copies and picture quality removes same-quality extras or lower-quality copies, keeping the best; a show in several folders shows each copy's quality and whether it's complete - keep the best of each episode or the complete copy; removed copies go to a StashBox Bin on the same drive (undo / put back / empty), or are deleted straight away if you choose. 1.5.2 - music is only looked for when you ask (Music > Look for music now); shows filed inside another show's folder (Star Trek's spin-offs, Doctor Who's) are found as shows of their own and looked up with the parent's name ('Spin-offs/Voyager' = Star Trek Voyager); 'Pick which folders in here are different shows' - tick each one, the rest stay part of the show, then match any TMDB didn't find straight from the list; 'split it up' keeps the folder's own seasons together. 1.5.1 - fixes from your report: the missing-episode search no longer claims a different show with the same name (classic Doctor Who), Windows 'Access is denied' when saving moves/undo fixed, whole shows aren't moved into someone else's pack folder; episode files named '103 - Title' / '01 - Title' / 'Episode 01', 19x01, a folder per episode, 'Part 1 of 7' folders, extras; show names like 'Seasons 1 to 26', '(2004-2007) - Complete TV Series', classic vs new shows told apart by season count, IMDb ids in folder names; film names with order numbers, leading years, ' - Fantasy', hyphens, scene-shortened files, CD1/CD2 folders; unmatched titles looked up again once; 'Not matched' lists and match by hand (suggestions, own words, TMDB/IMDb id). 1.5.0 - folders of several shows no longer read as one show with lots of seasons ('Bluey S01' / 'Peppa Pig Series 2' season folders, franchise folders, years in category names); sort out any folder yourself - split it into separate shows / films, count it as one, or leave it out (Folder rules); detailed scan log saying how every folder was read and why; export a problem report (zip, no passwords or keys). 1.4.0 - DVD / Blu-ray folder rips (VIDEO_TS / BDMV) named from their folders, incl. TV box sets; one drive can be in Movies and TV; Music: found anywhere on the NAS, tags read, artists / albums / covers, tidy into Artist / Album folders. 1.3.0 - where-is-it info for every title (every drive/folder, duplicates, look-alike entries); find missing episodes elsewhere on the NAS; put a show in one place (background move, undo); fixes for episodes missed in pack/batch folders, 'Other'/'Shorts' categories, '01 - Pilot' and '201' file names. 1.2.0 - collection / pack folders understood: order numbers like '01 ' taken off before matching, Collections shows your folders in your order with missing films to get, new films join their collection folder named like the rest. 1.1.0 - several NAS folders per section (USB drives on the NAS too), category folders understood and browsable, live scan progress showing the drive and folder, scan report, choose where new downloads are saved. 1.0.0 - first version.

extension.summary: Stream your TorBox cloud (torrents, usenet, web downloads) in Kodi
extension.description: Browse and play files from your TorBox account. Supports torrents, usenet and web downloads, adding magnets, deleting items, instant-cache checks, and optional Prowlarr/Jackett search. Requires a TorBox account and API key from torbox.app/settings.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on. Requires your own TorBox account. You are responsible for the content you access.

extension.summary: Movies, TV, anime, K-dramas and music from your TorBox cloud
extension.description: Browse and play movies, TV shows, anime (dub/sub), K-dramas and music through your TorBox account. Search with Torrentio, Nyaa, CocoScrapers, Torznab/Prowlarr and more, open season packs and albums, manage your TorBox torrents, usenet and web downloads, plus Cocoleech. Requires your own TorBox account and API key from torbox.app/settings.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on. Requires your own TorBox account. You are responsible for the content you access.
